mapper.select: SELECT A.BASIC_SEQ, A.BASIC_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.USEYN, A.BASIC_ORDER, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, B.STRE_FILE_NM, A.BASIC_STARTDAY, A.BASIC_ENDDAY, A.BASIC_STARTTIME, A.BASIC_ENDTIME, A.BASIC_TIMEDIV, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} ORDER BY A.BASIC_STARTDAY ASC, A.BASIC_STARTTIME ASC, A.BASIC_TIMEDIV DESC

SELECT A.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.STRE_FILE_NM, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.BASIC_STARTDAY AND A.BASIC_ENDDAY GROUP BY A.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.FILE_STRE_COURS, B.STRE_FILE_NM

SELECT A.BASIC_SEQ, A.BASIC_CODE, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.USEYN, A.BASIC_ORDER, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, B.STRE_FILE_NM, A.BASIC_STARTDAY, A.BASIC_ENDDAY, A.BASIC_STARTTIME, A.BASIC_ENDTIME, A.BASIC_TIMEDIV, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} AND #{searchDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BETWEEN A.BASIC_STARTDAY AND A.BASIC_ENDDAY ORDER BY A.BASIC_STARTDAY ASC, A.BASIC_STARTTIME ASC, A.BASIC_TIMEDIV DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODBASICFILE ( BASIC_SEQ, BASIC_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, USEYN, BASIC_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BASIC_STARTDAY, BASIC_ENDDAY, BASIC_STARTTIME, BASIC_ENDTIME, BASIC_TIMEDIV ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('basicbrodfile_seq'), #{basicCode}, #{atchFileId}, 'Y', #{basicOrder}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{basicStartDay}, #{basicEndDay}, #{basicStartTime}, #{basicEndTime}, #{basicTimeDiv} )
